title: Pastors warn humanity will come face-to-face with with alien beings
excerpt: A group of religious leaders who attended a secret meeting about UFO disclosure believe humanity is just months away from seeing the same things leaked in the Pentagon's files.
content:
A group of influential Christian leaders say Americans may soon come face-to-face with the strange phenomena in the Pentagon's UFO files. 

Bishop Alan DiDio, Pastor Larry Ragland and evangelist Tony Merkel were all attendees of a secret meeting between religious leaders and government insiders with knowledge of America's UFO disclosure plans earlier this year.

The three men recently sat down to reveal more about the experience, including how they were warned that the 'slow drip' of files was only the beginning of a disclosure campaign which would erupt in 2027.

DiDio said: 'I think this is just getting warmed up, especially in regard to what we heard about 2027.'

Merkel added the pastors were led to believe that 'the faucet is going to get turned on' next year, with Americans being shown more definitive proof of extraterrestrial beings and also seeing these objects and entities for themselves in real life.

To this point, there have only been eight batches of UFO files declassified to the public since the Pentagon's campaign began on May 8.

During that time, the government has released thousands of pages of government documents related to UFO sightings, images of mysterious objects and videos of strange spheres and other craft, but no 'smoking gun' that proves aliens are real.

In 2027, Merkel predicted: 'I think people are going to start experiencing the information they've been receiving. And I think those two things are probably going to go hand in hand.'

Some images from the Pentagon's declassified records included in the UFO files have been compared to angels flapping their wings

Tony Merkel (Left), Bishop Alan DiDio (Center) and Pastor Larry Ragland (Right) were all attendees of a secret UFO disclosure meeting in February 2026

The pastors' insights mainly came from retired US Army Green Beret Paul Bock during a meeting in a remote Airbnb in the Tennessee mountains in February.

Bock had previously told the Daily Mail that he acquired disturbing images of non-human beings during an independent investigation into UFOs and their possible connection to Scripture.

He reportedly revealed photographs showing ‘hyperdimensional’ creatures, including a squid-like being and a ghostly humanoid figure that appeared to exist outside the earthly realm. 

Ragland noted additional sources had also mentioned that 2027 would become a historic year and that intelligence agents claimed to be preparing for these beings to publicly 'reveal themselves' to humanity within months.

'He's a former CIA. He's been saying it for about 10 plus years that all the documents that he had seen, the things that he was told, is that '27 is the year... that they reveal themselves,' Ragland detailed.

'They are preparing to reveal themselves. If we don't get our act in order before '27, they're going to do something. That this is rumor. This is conjecture but this is what he's saying,' the pastor continued.

The trio noted that the latest batch of declassified UFO files, released on November 20, also mentioned mysterious findings at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long associated with UFO sightings, unidentified creatures and paranormal claims.

The release included a document known as The Ten Month Report, which lifted the lid on one of the strangest chapters in the Pentagon's history: a government-funded hunt for UFOs, ghosts and monsters on the remote cattle ranch. 

The Pentagon's UFO files specifically mentioned research into UFOs and paranormal phenomena taking place on a Utah property known as Skinwalker Ranch

While the public has largely looked at the files as 'nothing burgers,' the pastors argued a pattern had emerged, and that the Pentagon has been using small pieces of shocking information to gradually desensitize the public ahead of larger reveals in 2027.

DiDio said: 'I still believe there's a desensitization that's taking place.'

Ragland added: 'We've been conditioned to call this a nothing burger. I mean, 20 years ago, this would be life-altering information from our government. This is not a nothing burger. The mere fact your government says UFOs. Insane.'

Merkel, who is also a podcast host examining paranormal phenomena, revealed that he had spent about a week near the ranch.

He and others reported seeing a large shipping container that was mysteriously lifted, rotated and set back down on the property with no clear explanation of how it could have been moved.

He also saw lights in the sky and a large light beam shooting straight up into the sky from the top of a distant flat-topped desert hill.

Tony Merkel said a private meeting with intelligence officials revealed images of beings described as existing in two places at once (Stock Image)

The Daily Mail has spoken to multiple attendees at the UFO meeting, including DiDio and Merkel, but could not independently confirm that the private meetings took place as described or verify the images allegedly shown to the pastors.

The Pentagon’s main UFO investigative unit has said that most reports of mysterious phenomena in the sky have ordinary explanations, including balloons, drones and even birds.

Bock claimed his goal was not to simply tell Christians of an upcoming UFO disclosure campaign, but to warn believers of an alleged agenda to undermine faith in Christianity by suggesting that stories of heavenly beings in the Bible were misinterpreted UFO encounters.

In the podcast, released on Tuesday, the pastors echoed Bock's claims, seeing the revelations allegedly coming in 2027 as falling under the category of the Great Deception warned about in biblical passages such as Matthew 24.

The pastors believed the coming releases and potential encounters with unknown entities could challenge people’s views of humanity's origins and who or what deserves worship.

'Another word for disclosure is revelation,' Ragland said. 'Ultimately, the real disclosure is coming and it is coming in the sky and it ain't an alien and it ain't a ship.'
